snippet.title: Disciples: Domination | Announcement Trailer | US
snippet.description:
Disciples: Domination will be released in 2026 on PC (Steam, Epic Games), Xbox PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation®5.

Rule through the chaos! Fifteen years after Avyanna freed Nevendaar, Disciples: Domination returns you to a realm hanging in the balance. In this dark fantasy strategy RPG with turn-based combat, take your place on Queen Avyanna’s throne – holding together a crumbling kingdom.

*** 

Kalypso Media also publishes critically acclaimed strategy games like the Tropico series, Railway Empire, Commandos, Port Royale, Dungeons, Sudden Strike, and others for PC, PlayStation®, Xbox®, and Nintendo Switch™. Recent releases include Port Royale 4, Tropico 6 - Nintendo Switch™ Edition, Commandos 2 - HD Remaster, Tortuga - A Pirate's Tale, Railway Empire 2, Dungeons 4 and The Inquisitor.
